name: synthetic-qual-research
description: End-to-end orchestrator for synthetic-user qualitative research on the nvidia/Nemotron-Personas-Korea personas. Bundles five skills — synthetic-qual-research (the conductor: goal → survey → field → find ICP → deep interview → synthesize, owning a run directory, a reproducibility manifest, file-welded UUIDs, two human gates, and a validity caveat pass), backward-survey-builder (backward-design survey instruments for synthetic respondents), synthetic-icp-interview (field a survey on personas, select the ICP with evidence, run a deep in-character interview), synthetic-concept-test (pre-registers a decision and stimuli as locked files before showing 2+ blind concept/copy variants to N synthetic personas with randomized presentation order, then aggregates stopping/trust/intent reactions across three separate axes — never ranking or accepting/rejecting a variant), and synthetic-why-debrief (draft v0.1 — assembles a number-stripped scenario from a real post-experiment result, gates it on a domain-expert scenario review, then distills a human-led laddering interview into at most 3 'why' candidates). DEPENDS ON the nemotron-personas-korea plugin (persona-respondent agent, /persona-interviewee command, dataset loader, dispatch-strategy, synthetic-population-validity) and a local Python env with datasets+pandas and the cached dataset (~5.76GB).
